When recording the time since the last HIV test, specify the number and the unit of time using one letter: Days (D), Weeks (W), Months (M), or Years (Y). Indicate if the test was self-administered by the recipient or conducted by another end-user. For demographic data, record the sex of the individual as M for male or F for female, and provide their age in years. If applicable, indicate whether the individual has a sexual partner by marking Yes or No. For other end-users, record their sex and age in years. If an entire page needs to be discarded, mark it as Discard Whole Page. Do not cross out the entire record or page. Questions marked with an asterisk () are mandatory. In the event of a mistake in an oval, shade the incorrect oval and mark the correct one with an X. For example, if Yes is incorrect and No is correct, shade Yes and mark No with an X. If a mistake occurs in a box, shade the incorrect entry and write the correct answer close to it. For HIV self-test details, record the test name, kit lot number (letters and numbers only), expiry date (in the format dd/mm/yy), and serial number. Include the visit date (day in dd format), provider ID, and distribution point code. For condom distribution, record the type (male or female), the number distributed, and the age of the recipient. Use D, W, M, or Y to specify the time unit. Record the serial number, visit date (day in dd format), provider ID, and distribution point code. For HIV test results, indicate whether the individual is Never tested (Nev), Negative (Neg), Positive (Pos), Not on ART (No ART), On ART (On ART), or Inconclusive (Inconc). Specify if the test was self-administered (Self: Yes/No) and record the sex of the individual (M/F). If a record needs to be discarded, mark it accordingly. Ensure all data is accurately recorded and corrected as necessary.
